content:
**The Coop** is a location in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Atlantic City Boardwalk Paradise* update. It is located northwest of Vault 76 and east of Black Mountain Ordnance Works.

A location was established by Keith Cooper, who worked as an insurance CEO before the war. After Keith faked his death, [1] the group merged with the Crater Raiders and is led by Dicer who worries the group won't be able to survive without Keith.

Nestled into a cliffside, The Coop consists of an upper and lower level, with several stairs and walkways leading to and from each level.

The northern end has several Airplane Seats and Couches positioned around a bonfire. Above the bonfire, a Skeleton wearing a Party Hat and a Vault 76 Jumpsuit is trapped inside a cage. Next to a Portable Toilet is an Armor Workbench.

The upper level's southern end consists of an assembly space with several Benches, where Dicer is standing, and an elevated platform with a Chair acting as a throne.

To the left of the assembly, a ramp leads up to a bedroom with Keith Cooper's terminal and a Level 2-locked Safe, and another ramp leads to the lower level.

To the right of the assembly platform, another ramp leads down and into a small room to the left. In here, a Chemistry Station and Ammo Box can be found, as well as a Steamer Trunk around the corner.

The lower level consists of another room to the south, which is the resting place for Murry G. Bones. Another Chemistry Station and an orange Level 1-locked Explosives Crate can also be found here.

Two walkways are found to the north, a short one with a Power Armor Station, and a longer one leading to a red couch and a makeshift table.

The Coop appears in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Atlantic City Boardwalk Paradise* update.
